notes.title: Rollback To Previous Version
notes.notes:
Dear Players
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the performance issues reported in the latest version of the game. To ensure a better gaming experience, we have decided to roll back to the previous stable version. This decision was made to prevent further impact on your gameplay.

For those who enjoy the new features introduced in the latest version, we have moved it to a preview branch named [feature_newui]. You can switch to this branch to continue using the new version if you prefer.

Our team is actively working on resolving the issues, and once the fixes are implemented, we will re-release the updated version. We appreciate your patience and support, and we are committed to avoiding similar situations in the future.

How to Switch to the New UI Branch:
1. Right-click on the game in your Steam LIBRARY.  
2. Select "properties...".  
3. Go to the "Betas" tab.  
4. Choose the [feature_newui] branch from the dropdown menu.  
5. Close the page, and the game will update automatically.  

To Switch Back to the Default Branch:
Follow the same steps, but select "None" from the dropdown menu.

We have more features & content coming this year. Be sure to follow/wishlist and join our amazing community!
 Official Discord

Patch Note: Hotfix for Avatar & Desktop

VR 0.4.0.4589：

 Tweaked grip sensitivity on index controller to avoid unintentional triggering.
 Disabled bloom effect on avatar skin so it's no longer overly bright.
 Fixed an issue that custom avatar body not rendered in LIV camera.
 Fixed an issue that BGM stops playing after UI popup windows shown.
 Fixed an issue that traps getting pushed sideways near the end of the stage.
 Fixed an issue that ACE rating icon turns white on song end UI.
 

Desktop 0.3.8.4549：

 Supports 60fps feed on more camera models.
 Fixed an issue that hit-detection breaks after re-calibrating mid-game and restarting level.
 Fixed an issue that some mid-air obstacles may block camera view.

notes.title: Patch Note 0.4.0.4473 - And one more！
notes.notes:
New Feature！

Added In-Game Avatar Support
Requires 2 foot trackers & 1 waist tracker to use

Supports Custom Avatars in VRM format
Put your VRM files into [\Dance Dash_Data\StreamingAssets\Avatars]

Known Issues
Characters may appear overly bright due to bloom
Avatars with complex materials may be rendered incorrectly
Some Avatars may have scale and binding issues

We’ll continue to improve the compatibility of this feature

One More Thing！

Added Camera Tracking Preview for VR version
You can use a webcam to track your feet while holding controllers in your hands
This would help with headsets that having difficulties tracking controllers on feet
Switch to [Betas > feature_preview] from the game properties page to check out this new feature!

For camera related issues, please check the guide for desktop version
Camera Setup Guides

 Normal, which is 2.4 meters wide
 Middle, which is 1.8 meters wide
